title: 1638 Prairie's front fence, from its photograph
items: The Gothic house at 1638 Prairie now stands behind the fence its old photograph shows on the street line: two gate piers either side of an open gateway, each cap pierced with a heart and topped with an iron finial, and low iron bars on a pale stone base.
Where the photograph runs out, the fence is carried on to the lot lines, and that is written down as a liberty.
